visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a black V-neck t-shirt and a silver wristwatch, stands in an indoor room. He holds a black handheld microphone in his right hand. The background consists of a tall, grey grommet-top curtain and a dark vertical panel on the left. A large pink text overlay reading "Back Pain In This Area (BlackPink Parody)" is positioned at the bottom-center. His expression is one of mock-seriousness as he looks slightly off-camera. (2) The man begins lip-syncing with high emotional intensity, furrowing his brow and squinting his eyes to simulate distress. He shifts the microphone to his left hand while his right hand reaches behind his back to grip his waist, emphasizing physical pain. Pink subtitles appear at the top of the frame. The room lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of his shirt and the curtain behind him. (3) He continues his performance with rhythmic movements, alternating between pointing at the camera and clutching his lower back. The camera remains mostly static but rapid straight cuts change the framing slightly. Various pink subtitles detailing his back struggles appear near the top. He wears a red beaded bracelet on his right wrist. The setting remains constant with the grey curtains and indoor studio-like atmosphere. (4) In the climax, the man dances more vigorously to the heavy beat, rotating his torso while keeping his hands near his lower back. The editing pace accelerates, with cuts occurring on every major beat of the song. The pink text overlays change rapidly to match the lyrics about cracking sounds and back pain. His facial expressions oscillate between intense singing and comedic grimacing, effectively conveying the parody's theme.
